description.content:
Creates the resources recommended to [setup](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o25a0034) Coveo for Commerce in a [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - Edit

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"EDIT","targetId":"{body.trackingId}"} ```

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`
